name: Kamptal

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

terms: Austrian quality wine from approved grape varieties, tested by the state before sale. Prädikatswein and DAC wines sit within it.
Districtus Austriae Controllatus, Austria's rules for regionally typical wines. The wine must show the typical character of its area.

blurb.text: A wine area in Niederösterreich (Lower Austria), Austria, whose Kamptal DAC wine is white, from Grüner Veltliner and Riesling, joined from the 2024 vintage by Chardonnay, Weissburgunder and Grauburgunder. Grüner Veltliner covers 55 percent of its vineyards and Riesling 10, with Zweigelt also planted.
